# OxyLux Solutions

> OxyLux Solutions is a clinic in Miami Lakes, Florida, open since November 2, 2026. Slogan: Personalized care. Elevated wellness. Its signature therapies are hyperbaric oxygen therapy, IV therapy, post-surgical massage, peptide therapy and weight management (Wellness and Recovery), plus Venus Legacy, PRP therapy and Botox injections (Aesthetic Treatments). Hyperbaric oxygen therapy uses a modern Oxycell OxyPro Genesis hard-shell chamber. All treatments are supervised by a board-certified surgeon. Spanish is spoken. The Founder and Medical Director is Dr. Fermin Morales, MD, FACS.

- Address: 14361 Commerce Way, Suite 201, Miami Lakes, FL 33016, United States
- Phone: (353) 465-0532
- Email: frontdesk@oxyluxsolutions.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM (Eastern). Closed Saturday and Sunday.
- Languages: English and Spanish
- Booking: online at https://www.oxyluxsolutions.com/reserve (choose a time and service, then sign that service's consent form), or by phone
- Insurance: most major plans accepted for eligible services; coverage depends on the plan and diagnosis. Cosmetic services are usually not covered.
